description: Create a hosted Stripe checkout link for a prepaid top-up. A human must open the link and pay; no money moves until they do. Needs an API key with the billing:topup scope.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key; retries with the same key return the same link instead of creating a new one

package_id.description: Top-up package from get_pricing, for example pilot or growth. Defaults to pilot

name: create_topup_link
title: Create a top-up payment link
